newsitem.title: USA: CME live and feeder cattle calls range mixed.
newsitem.headline: CME live and feeder cattle calls range mixed.

text.p: Early calls on CME live and feeder cattle futures ranged from 0.100 cent higher to 0.100 lower, analysts said.

December live cattle were expected to show carryover support as they continued to narrow the basis to cash. Cash cattle sold at $66 per cwt this week and December was at $65.65 Tuesday with no delivery notices posted due to its discount to cash, analysts said.
However, resistance is still expected in deferreds following the continued weak cash beef market and outlook for increased fed cattle supplies later, they said.
Light-weight choice boxed beef prices declined another $0.71 per cwt Tueday to $108.23, the lowest price since Oct 30.

Early expectations for next week's monthly Cattle-on-Feed report pointed to continued heavy placements onto feedlots during November and on-feed supplies now above the year ago level. The report outlook should keep a lid on deferreds.

Feeder cattle will likely take their cue from live cattle and could range mixed. A higher CME feeder cattle index is supportive while higher corn futures indications was viewed as a pressuring influence, they added.
The latest index was up $0.30 at $64.83 per cwt.
